newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Morgan Stanley revises U.S. stocks forecast - paper.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley revises U.S. stocks forecast - paper.

text.p: U.S. brokerage Morgan Stanley revised its forecast made in April for a 1,000-point fall in the Dow Jones Industrial Average and U.S. 30-year Treasury yields leap to eight percent, the South China Morning Post said on Friday.
Visiting Morgan Stanley chief investment strategist Byron Wien and chief economist Stephen Roach said the U.S. equity market still had a bit of a run left in it.
"Steve and I had a great presentation. We even agreed; but we were wrong," Wien told the Post.
